headline: Musk accuses Ukraine's Zelenskyy of lying about Starshield outages
summary: Elon Musk said Ukrainian president Volodymyr Zelenskyy is lying about disruptions to Starshield and accused him of trying to misuse SpaceX's consumer Starlink service for military purposes. Musk made the comments at The New York Times' DealBook Summit. Coverage varies in tone, from framing the remarks as an explanation to framing them as an accusation.
